sigil.name: Fortune's Wheel
sigil.text: A long gaming hall with a gilded wheel mounted on its roof. Striped awnings and open doors line the front.

sigil.name: Funicular
sigil.text: A tavern on wheels that seems to teeter on the edge of Sigil. Every once in a while it rolls by, or you can spot it across the ring.

sigil.name: Secret Door Safe House
sigil.text: A plain door in a plain wall. It is rarely in the same wall twice.
